verdict.rationale: Vapi documents Composer, a built-in assistant where you "describe what you want to build and Composer handles the technical setup," so users can hand off setup tasks to an in-product AI. The evidence is a single thin doc line. The MCP server and CLI IDE integration serve external assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor) rather than a built-in one, so they are not credited, and Vapi's "assistants" are voice agents users build, not helpers for the user. Missing for 10: details of which tasks Composer can perform, how it executes changes in the dashboard, its limits, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
